name: Feed the Fire 🔥
desc:
🔥 Feed the fire. Grow it bigger. Beat the storm! 🔥

Drag logs, batteries, explosives and fireworks into your fire and watch it roar. Every piece of fuel you burn earns you money, and the bigger your fire gets, the more you earn!

But a storm is always coming. When the clock runs out, the rain pours down, and only a fire big enough can survive it. Each storm is angrier than the last: Drizzle, Shower, Rainfall, Downpour, Storm... and the terrible Tempest.

⭐ Spend your money on a giant upgrade tree where every buy reveals more
⚡ Unlock new fuels: lightning chains, huge explosions and firework blasts
🏭 Build spawners that feed your fire for you
🔥 Level your fire up to Level 50
🏆 Climb the leaderboards

How big can YOUR fire get?

llm.loop: drag fuel into your fire -> earn money -> buy upgrade tree nodes & fuels -> fire must be big enough to survive each storm
llm.objectives: grow the fire to survive ever-bigger storms
llm.progression: upgrade tree, fire level to 50, new fuels, spawners
llm.instructions: drag logs, batteries, explosives into fire; beat the storm
unique: storm deadline turns an idle incremental into survival rounds
llm.thumbnails: cartoon fire growing vs angry storm cloud
llm.complexity_notes: simple field, physics fuel, upgrade tree UI
